What the stats mean

Win rate is the fraction of completed AI hands marked as wins. Net chips is the sum of recorded simulated hand results, not real money. Decision accuracy applies only to the separate preflop trainer. These stats measure practice activity; they do not certify that a decision is solver-optimal.
